title: Listeria monocytogenes meningitis (Clinical Case Reports, 2018; 6(6): 1195)

claims.text: On CSF culture, Listeria monocytogenes appeared as gram-positive bacilli (rods) with tumbling motility.
claims.byte_quote: CSF cultures revealed blue–gray colonies that comprised gram‐positive bacilli with tumbling motility (Video S1 ), which was turned out to be Listeria monocytogenes

claims.text: Listeria is an aerobic, beta-hemolytic, gram-positive bacillus that exhibits tumbling motility on light microscopy.
claims.byte_quote: Listeria is an aerobic, beta‐hemolytic, gram‐positive bacillus, which exhibits tumbling motility on light microscopy 1

claims.text: Listeria monocytogenes is described as a food-borne pathogen.

cites: Farber, J. M., and Peterkin P. I. 1991. Listeria monocytogenes, a food-borne pathogen. Microbiol. Rev. 55:476-511.
